name: @nordic-regulated-ai-agent-platform/workspace
description: Workspace tooling for the Nordic Regulated AI Agent Platform.

scripts.format:python: uv run ruff format apps services packages scripts
scripts.format:check:python: uv run ruff format --check apps services packages scripts
scripts.lint:python: uv run ruff check apps services packages scripts
scripts.typecheck:python: uv run mypy apps services packages scripts
scripts.security:static: uv run bandit -q -r apps services packages scripts -c bandit.yaml
scripts.security:check: pnpm security:static && pnpm security:python-deps && pnpm security:node-deps && pnpm security:secrets
scripts.dev:up: docker compose --env-file .env.example up --build --wait --detach web api worker postgres redis azurite && docker compose --env-file .env.example up --detach azurite-init
scripts.release:build: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/production-local.env.example -f docker-compose.production.yml build --quiet web api worker
scripts.release:up: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/production-local.env.example -f docker-compose.production.yml up --build --wait --detach web api worker postgres redis azurite && docker compose --env-file infra/docker/production-local.env.example -f docker-compose.production.yml up --detach azurite-init
